text: MAN Truck & Bus is a company of the TRATON GROUP (MAN SE was merged into TRATON SE in 2021). TRATON SE's largest single shareholder is Volkswagen International Luxemburg S.A., a Volkswagen Group company, which held 87.52% of the share capital at 31 December 2025.
short: MAN is a TRATON GROUP brand; Volkswagen holds 87.52% of TRATON.

source.name: MAN Truck & Bus – Strategy (MAN at a glance)
source.quote: MAN Truck & Bus is a company of TRATON GROUP and employs some 32,000 people worldwide.
